title: Historical briefings cut off in the early 2010s
summary: UAPGerb tells of Historical briefings cut off in the early 2010s, about early 2010s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there was an initiative in the early 2010s to cut off historical briefings on new on new program incumbents.

plain: An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels that, in the early 2010s, there was an effort inside the US government to stop giving historical briefings to people newly put in charge of secret programmes. He passes this on from someone he spoke with. If true, it would mean new officials were kept from learning the background of what they were running.
